parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you created the production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you created a production studio in the Live console, go to **Live console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.
